Panoramic terraces and the outdoor living areas are the real highlight of this property, wonderful lucious outdoor entertainment and landscaped garden areas, fish ponds and gorgeous sparkling pool give pleasant and relaxing moments in the open air with the splendor of Africa's wild life that surrounds you!

title: Truss House, Bedfordview
description: Tucked away in a safe and secure street in the heart of Bedfordview, lies this exquisite entertainers dream home. Upon entry to this beautiful home, you are greeted by high wooden truss ceilings and double volume windows ensuring ample light enters the property creating a warm living area which oozes luxury and tranquility, opening out onto a well maintained, spacious garden and sparkling blue swimming pool as well as a pond. The kitchen is neat with ultra modern finishes, light grey wooden built-in cupboards, built-in SMEG gas stove, caesar stone counter tops and a separate sculler allowing space for kitchen appliances.

This home comprises of 4 luxurious bedrooms that are are spacious with laminated wooden flooring, white wood built-in cupboards and garden views and 3 bathrooms, 2 being en-suite. The main bedroom boasts a walk-in closest and has on offer an en-suite bathroom that is tiled to the ceiling with a glass shower, bath tub, toilet and vanity.

title: Rooftop Cluster, Bedfordview
description: This stunner offers privacy from its own entrance. It has an amazing designer kitchen open plan dinning room for fine dinning entertainment. There are 5 large bedrooms all en suite bathrooms. The main bedroom has large dressing area and full bathroom.There are 2 private balcony's, rooftop garden, guest bathroom,designer pool and garden plus a staff accommodation.
This is a perfect lock up and go. Nothing lacking. Well located with top class security features bringing you peace of mind

title: House, Hazeldean
description: Negotiations Invited From R9million - Asking Price R11million. Once in a lifetime do you come across a property with extraordinary designer elements, available to the Connoisseur of Life who appreciates the finer things in life. The welcoming residence enjoys various reception areas, including a formal lounge, family room, dining room and covered patio which accommodates both a lounge and dining set. Quality workmanship is evident and top luxury finishes compliments this residence throughout. The swimming pool enjoys a decked lounge area overlooking the private garden. A designer kitchen to make all your meal preparations a great enjoyment while all the practical elements adds to the comfort. A downstairs guest suite is privately situated while the elegant staircase leads to a pyjama lounge and and three king size bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms. The master bedroom suite, enjoys a spacious lounge, walk-in dressing room and a balcony overlooking the garden.
conflicts: Caption headline shows R9,000,000; body reads “Negotiations invited from R9million – Asking Price R11million”. Asking price used.

title: Villa Rosemarimo
description: Two new villas hitting Camps Bay, February 2022 .The design of this villa takes full advantage of what the site has to offer, with an emphasis on ocean and mountain views while at the same time creating a serene private world for each villa enhanced by the feeling of “living in nature” through the creation of landscaped courtyards and green roofs. Large sliding doors are fitted to both sides of the living area, allowing uninterrupted views through the building while at the same time maximizing the opportunity for indoor-outdoor living.

title: Glass House, Constantia
description: A modern family home offering superior style by using glass, metal & concrete in a creative way to maximise natural lighting and to make the most of the beautiful gardens around the property. Large floor to ceiling windows, high ceilings, fireplaces & a floating staircase all encourage a minimalist undertone to the home with expansive open plan living spaces.

This double storey property is positioned in this highly sought after pocket of Constantia with easy access to Rhodes drive. All 4 bedrooms are ensuite, there is a separate study, staff accommodation, balconies, large covered outdoor entertainment area. There are 2 properties within the development both on 2000sqm, with their own separate entrances. Price excludes VAT & No transfer duty payable.

title: Triple-volume House, Dainfern
description: This masterpiece of design, technology, and style is one of a kind.

Another masterpiece was designed by Kapa architects on this special piece of land. Dainfern’s finest truly one-of-a-kind, Bespoke added triple volume grand entrance, Open plan large living spaces, and are greeted by amazing views through the floor to ceiling glass doors. Spaces flow from living room to dining room into the @blu_linesa designed kitchen with all the trimmings. There is also a private study with its own magical views onto the golf course and river.

Outdoors the heated infinity swimming pool, jacuzzi, and tanning step. The large entertainment area outside includes a sunken fire pit and outdoor kitchen including; pizza oven and a built-in Braai area with an automated awning

Upstairs there are 4 en-suit bedrooms each with its own style and the extraordinary master bedroom suite has a beautiful luxury handcrafted dressing room and elegant en suit bathroom. In the middle of the host of bedroom suites is an breathtaking informal lounge with magnificent views.

title: House, Waterkloof Ridge
description: Undoubtedly one of the best properties you can find in Pretoria East! Brand new modern masterpiece that is a true delight to all the senses. No expense was spared in designing and completing this home - striking features, combination of textures and materials to please the senses and create a feeling of comfort and luxury. A home to feel proud of and enjoy living in.
For the discerning property connoisseur - this home will be a timeless investment to enjoy

title: House, Atholl
description: This well-designed home exudes the latest in the contemporary sleek styling of a top international designer.

This well designed home exudes the latest in the contemporary sleek styling of a top international designer, with meticulous attention to detail, the reception areas flow freely to spacious patios, gardens and pool.From the double volume entrance hall, the floating glass and stone staircase leads to the upstairs library and pyjama lounge, the luxurious main bedroom suites includes a palatial dressing room and fully equipped bathroom. Four further bedroom suites complete the accommodation. Offering total privacy and security, this home offers the lucky few, the opportunity to live a lifestyle few can emulate

title: The Azure
description: The Azure comprises 4 landmark residences in the heart of Camps Bay, just 150m from the beach. Each residence has 4-ensuite bedrooms and a bespoke Italian designer chef’s kitchen with a separate scullery and fully integrated appliances. The Azure offers its residents uninterrupted battery back-up power and independent water supply.
The Azure in Camps Bay has won an International Property Award for Residential Property in South Africa at the 2020-2021 Arabia & Africa Property Awards 🏆
Independent water supply, battery back-up, provision for electric car charging and a pool water recycling system are just some of the technological features included in The Azure.

title: House, Culross Enclosure
description: Created with high-end living in mind this awe-inspiring architectural design combines minimalism, refined finishes and attention to detail. Located in the highly sought after Culross guarded enclosure.

Seamlessly integrated indoor and outdoor living areas to feature pool deck and spacious garden. 4 Generously proportioned bedroom suites, 2 studies, pyjama lounge, guest cloakroom, staff, triple garaging.
Finishes include high ceilings and doors, bulkheads, imported kitchen cabinetry, solar geysers.

title: Koi-pond House, Zimbali
description: The moment one walks into this masterpiece home, you feel immediate relaxation and tranquility come over you. Designed with state of the art electronic systems, one can control almost the entire house by a click of a button.

A koi pond flows throughout many areas of the home and the extensive heated rim flow pool stretches around the exterior entertainment area giving one a feeling of being surrounded by water. An open plan state of the art kitchen, living and dining room area flows out onto the large open plan entertainment area giving a feeling of space whilst being naturally lit. If one is seeking some entertainment rather, then walk down to your private "Man-Cave" cinema room which is custom fitted with high end media and sound equipment along with comfortable leather seats. There is also a bar, toilet, snooker table and other entertainment items included down here.
The 4 luxury bedrooms are all with bathroom en-suites designed in such a way to introduce the surroundings to be part of the bedrooms.
Zimbali is considered 1 of the best in South Africa’s premier and most exclusive lifestyle estates.

title: House, Copperleaf
description: This home is both majestic and empowering. An impressive home, warm and inviting, with vast entertainment and living areas centred around a huge open-plan kitchen. Magnificent mood lighting throughout this home. 5 Bedrooms, all en-suite, 4 upstairs and 1 downstairs. Study or gym room opening to pool area. Two lounges, dining room, entertainment room with gas cooker and built-in braai as well as a cinema room.

Designer kitchen featuring two cooking areas, island unit with breakfast area, walk-in pantry, scullery and laundry. 4 Garages and staff quarters. Biggest pool in Copperleaf with built-in spa-bath large enough to seat over a dozen people. Once you venture upstairs on the floating staircase you will find a further 4 bedrooms all en-suite with balconies and a large pyjama lounge with patio as well as a storage or prayer room.

The large en-suite bedroom has wonderful views over the fairway and luxurious bathroom with spa bath and outdoor shower. A lovely walk-through dressing room completes the picture. Beam central vacuum system. Heronbridge Private School and Pecanwood is nearby. A must to view.

title: Mountain Estate, Cape Town
description: A sublime ultra-luxurious home designed by Shaun Altendorff nestled on 2+ acre plot surrounded by landscaped gardens and tranquil mountain views.

The double volume entry unveils an entertainer’s delight paired with elegance and sophistication. Offering Gaggenau and Siemens appliances and granite countertops. A grand staircase leads to an opulent master bedroom, spacious en-suite bathroom, walk-in dressing room, 4 additional bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, Meditation Room, Wine Cellar.
Additional features include: 2-bedroom apartment, 2 staff apartments, laundry, gym, borehole, pool, water filtration system, Paradox alarm system, solar panels, Perkins generator

title: Pond House, Morningside
description: Positioned at the top of a cul de sac , this immaculate property boasts stunning modern architecture and design with exceptional use of space.
The approach to the front door is breath taking. You cross a huge crystal clear pond, surrounded by tropical vegetation, on concrete stepping stones and arrive at the huge pivot door.

The expansive lounge, dining and kitchen spaces open to a magnificent entertainment area which has a double covered patio with gas grill and imported Italian pizza oven. Exceptional heated pool with waterfall features, is flanked by another entertainment space with a jacuzzi and day bed deck and a fire pit with seating under the stars. All set in an exquisitely landscaped garden.

The Pavini ultra modern gourmet Italian kitchen has a centre island, with integrated appliances and designer cabinetry, shelving and wine rack. A spacious lock up pantry opens into the scullery/laundry space which in turn opens to a designed for purpose herb garden.

Down stairs also hosts a fitted study and an equipped gym with bathroom. There is extensive home automation and security systems. Upstairs has three bedrooms en suite with a pyjama lounge and open plan study with coffee station.

title: House, Eccleston Drive
description: Heres the deal, Opulent 5 Bedroom home located on the exclusive Eccleston drive in the prestigious suburb of Bryanston. This luxurious 800sqm home boasts five spacious bedrooms all en-suite, each bedroom is further complimented with their own balconies which offer views of the greater surrounding area of Sandton.

Nothing but designer finishes throughout with brands such as @hansgrohe and @gaggenauofficial appliances. The stylish architecture displaying ultra-modern living spaces and invites natural light in with the continuous use of glass throughout and elevated ceilings. Four glamourous reception and guest rooms.

This home is an entertainer’s dream, with a fully fitted modern bar, home automation system, undercover patio and outside Lapa which overlooks an inviting 12-meter swimming pool and manicured gardens with panoramic views. The Pool has electronic pool cover that disappears when open. Placed perfectly on a 1610sqm stand this is truly something spectacular. In a secure estate with 24 hr guarding of six very upmarket homes

title: Enclave House, Hyde Park
description: Set behind two security booms, both manned by security guards. The most secure, private and exclusive enclave in sought after Hyde Park. A rare offering of one of the area’s finest properties. Nestled in Hyde Park’s most exclusive roads, this enchanting home can arguably be described as the very best of the best. A Keith Mason designed home, inspired by Sir Edwin Luyten’s architecture, this home arranged over three levels is spectacular in every way. ‘Flair, brilliance and an unerring eye for proportions’ perfectly depicts his style. A masterpiece of light and space, the impressive double volume entrance hall welcomes you in with views from the front door, right through to the garden. The seamless flow of this home marries all of the open plan reception rooms beautifully. Two lounges, formal dining room, study and exquisite undercover patio overlooking the lavish garden, pool and pool house. Elaborate entertaining is made easy in any space of this residence. The state of the art designer kitchen includes an informal dining area that looks out onto a pond and rose bushes, behind stackable glass doors. Ground floor with an entertainment area like no other - complete with a wine cellar, music room and home theatre.

Going up to the top floor, either by the lift or sweeping staircase, there are four bedrooms each perfectly positioned around a centre atrium. Each room is private, having it’s own en-suite and dressing room. This home has been meticulously designed with not one expense spared.

title: Hilltop House, Linksfield Ridge
description: Welcome to this 5 story modern mansion situated on a hilltop in a safe and secure area, with some of the best views money can buy. Probably one of the best inland listing in South Africa.
Designed and built to the highest standard by CM Architects & Interiors (Cimato Architects)
This is a property you want to see in person the photos only do that much to showcase how iconic this home is.

title: Ridge House, Westcliff
description: Unique contemporary home in heritage area, honestly one of Westcliff finest homes for Sale. This home offers come of the best views of Johannesburg truly better in person.

“The clients’ brief was to create a sustainable modern home that exploited views from the site, which is situated just off the Valley road on the Westcliff ridge and overlooks the jacaranda trees of the Northern suburbs parks and Johannesburg Zoo.”

title: House, Simbithi
description: This is without a doubt a wow Home. If you are not blown away by the impressive double volume entrance hall with bespoke chandelier and twin sweeping case then the main bedroom will have you dropping your jaw. Perfectly suited to the big family family wanting to enjoy the perks of living together as a family but still allowing the opportunity to escape the privacy of their own spaces. This is the one you want next!

title: House, Baronetcy Estate
description: Views to Die for -This extraordinarily beautiful home offers luxury living at its finest.

The entertainment space overlooks a rim flow pool shimmering in the sunlight and panoramic views, with Table Mountain taking centre stage from all viewpoints of the home. A sublime reception area with soaring ceilings and wine room welcome you in warmly. Feature walls, lovely flooring and exquisite finishes all around add to the aura of the perfectly positioned family home.

The beautifully appointed kitchen with separate scullery flows effortlessly to the dining area, TV room and second lounge with a Jacuzzi room to top it off. The main bedroom is a prime selling point of this immaculate property, with views galore. No matter the weather, waking up or going to bed, you will be in for a treat. It is accompanied with an en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet.
The double garage has direct access to the home plus a separate living space with a well-designed full bathroom. Both the lounge and bedroom lead out on to the lower garden area.

This section could be used for guests, visiting family members or a teenager looking to move out without the trouble of actually moving out. From its elevated position and situated in a spectacularly striking part of the Western Cape, Baronetcy Estate offers a rare opportunity for homeowners to enjoy natural eco-living within the comfort of a secure gated community.

title: House, Senderwood
description: Masterpiece home in Senderwood designed by award winning Architects Nico van der Meulen Architects

Magnificent open plan home with double volume high ceilings. Exquisite open plan spaces opening onto huge patio. Light space and airyness. Open plan lounge, dining room and TV room which closes off from the main lounge. Study or guest suite downstairs. State of the Art pen plan kitchen with stainless steel island and counter tops. Huge pantry and scullery with ample storage and SMEG fridge/freezer and appliances with gas hod. Downstairs study or 4th bedroom and full bathroom with Duravit and Purarida finishes. Upstairs 3 bedrooms (all en suite). The Master bedroom has a kitchenette and exquisite “his” and “hers” dressing room. The other two bedrooms en suite with walk in cupboards.

North facing with fully landscaped garden and water features. Other features of this magnificent home - balcony and roof top garden, solid Meranti staircase, walk ways, louvres and garage doors. Staff accommodation with separate entrance, underfloor heating, automated irrigation system and excellent security.

title: Penthouse, Foreshore
description: A cut above the rest, this penthouse is the epitome of luxury and style, combined in one sleek effort.

This is the place for you when only the best will do. The perfect penthouse, opulent, luxurious and not a single detail has been left out. Panoramic views of the whole of Cape Town. A perfect place to entertain or relax high above the hustle of the city.

A massive terrace outside to entertain and three en-suite bedrooms connected through open plan kitchen and a colossal living room.The unit has UDZ status and can be zero-rated for VAT and comes with an annual gross income of R1.2m from its first year on Airbnb.
